Chapter 6923: Timeflow Firmament

Chapter 6923: Timeflow Firmament

Ancient was one of the nine major worlds, believed to be the oldest among them. Some disputed this and claimed Ruin to be the oldest, followed by Golden Mortal World.

However, since these two were gone, Ancient had the top spot. In its long history, it produced numerous overlords and immortals. Nevertheless, three primordial immortals stood out in particular - Apex Immortal, Heaven’s Equal Immortal Monarch, and Breaker Immortal.

They were survivors of many wars, protecting their world from destruction. Eventually, they and the world agreed on their reign; territories were divided.

Thus, the countless firmaments in Ancient were ruled by them and their descendants or followers.

Timeflow was a firmament under Heaven’s Equal Immortal Monarch’s jurisdiction. It was a relatively large one with numerous continents and oceans.

For an ordinary cultivator, they would never be able to travel across this firmament in a lifetime. Therefore, they had no idea the sheer number of firmaments outside.

Only emperors could leave a firmament. Thus, it resembled the nine worlds, albeit easier to leave in practice. There were no threats of tribulations or separating barriers.

This was the greatest advantage of Heavenrealm for emperors. Upon reaching this level, they could travel and experience countless worlds.

Any cultivator in Timeflow was under Heaven’s Equal’s banner, meaning they had access to one-third of Ancient’s territories. If they could officially join the branch, everything would become simpler.

The same couldn’t be said about visitors from the nine worlds and six continents. For a long period, emperors from outside worlds were hunted since they were viewed as delicacies. Some were captured to be used as toys or bargaining chips.

Reaching the ancestral realm or the overlord realm was a true struggle. Nonetheless, they united and fought bravely, eventually establishing safe havens.

Of course, they also received help during this process. For example, Origination Enterprise and Golden World.

There were conditions and debts to be repaid. Eventually, the alliance known as Guardian was formed. At first, they hid in a small corner, awaiting the right moment to strike.

Once they became strong enough, they swept through the enemies and obtained two major worlds - Grand Thousand and Heavenly Desolace.

Li Qiye smiled upon entering and scanning Ancient. He focused his gaze on a firmament and entered Timeflow.

In this vast world, a light could be seen flowing above at all times. It was particularly intense in the most sacred Firmament Palace.

Rumor has it that all the dao in this world originated from it. Numerous sects were started with this original dao.

When future descendants became emperors or ancient ancestors, they would join the palace. Furthermore, leaving the firmament required its guidance and introduction. Some lucky souls might be able to meet the immortal monarch in the future. Therefore, the natives’ most ambitious goal was entry to the palace.

Today, numerous emperors and ancient ancestors stood outside to listen to Timeflow Lord’s dao lecture.

They gathered on a square surrounded by an ocean with rippling light waves. The lord sat in a meditative pose and calmly preached.

The words of the dao descended and halos circled him, creating visions of worlds and stars. Listeners wanted nothing more than this rare opportunity.

After all, a lecture only occurred once every hundred thousand years or even longer. It was an honor to be among the crowd.
